practice_statement: Ideas made monumental. Art, engineering and fabrication brought together to create landmarks, environments and experiences.
about_intro: Scheed Cole is a Jamaican sculptor, visual artist, educator, trainer and fabricator. His practice sits at the intersection of art and applied design, combining sculptural sensitivity with the engineering required to realise ambitious work at scale.
contact_intro: For monumental sculpture, public art, hospitality, attractions, museums, cultural projects and custom fabrication.
